WITH j AS (
  SELECT ft.account_id AS account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ft.account_id, c.town_city
),
t AS (
  SELECT town, SUM(cnt) AS town_total FROM j GROUP BY town
),
m AS (
  SELECT j.account_id, j.town, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / t.town_total AS share
  FROM j JOIN t ON j.town = t.town
),
avg_t AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM m WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT m.account_id, m.town, m.cnt, m.share, CAST(m.cnt AS REAL) / avg_t.avg_cnt AS ratio
FROM m CROSS JOIN avg_t
WHERE avg_t.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
